notes: Build sizes are rounded uncompressed per-asset figures from the latest Unity build log; they are not PNG file sizes or downloaded APK sizes.
Packing is a no-resize CPU feasibility simulation at 2048 with 4px padding per side, no rotation, power-of-two trimmed pages. Not a Unity build measurement.
Half-resolution experiments are numeric packing simulations only; no resampling or asset change was performed. Visual approval at target scale is still required.
BC7 numbers assume 8bpp and supported standalone target; no compression quality acceptance is implied.
No source assets, importer settings, loaders or delivered builds were modified.
